An influential '''crime lord''' operated during the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Opal Foundation]], based on [[Koru Neimoidia/Legends|Koru Neimoidia]], was in reality a front for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord's]] activities.<ref name="Follow the Money">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Follow the Money}}</ref>
